sources.quote: Consider the well operated by Diamondback E&P LLC in Martin County. The disclosure for that well utilizes a systems approach format but still conceals the identity of 7 chemicals, which means 63% of ingredients are listed as trade secrets.
sources.searcher_note: Open-FF Texas trade-secret post uses one Diamondback well as an example; no operator-level rate or ranking for Diamondback. Page metadata shows dateModified 2026-07-21.

sources.quote: Across all valid Texas chemical records, 16.3% are marked as trade secrets. Trade secret claims appear in 86.1 % of all disclosures.
sources.searcher_note: Same page as above, second quote: the statewide Texas rate (16.3% of records) that the lead's 16.2% compares against. Counts as one source.

sources.quote: Here is an example of trade secret records: the figure below is an excerpt of the disclosure for the Texas well 42-227-40269-00-00 by Diamondback E&P in August 2022 with the proprietary records marked with red.
sources.searcher_note: Uses one Diamondback Texas well as an illustration of proprietary records; national figure is 15% of records proprietary. No Diamondback-wide rate.

sources.quote: Chesapeake Operating Company reported the most proprietary claims: 31,239 total, representing 91.4% of their total disclosures.
sources.searcher_note: Peer-reviewed study ranking top 10 operators by proprietary claims 2014-2022 (Chesapeake, Pioneer 96.7%, XTO 86.3%); Diamondback not found in the text (figure 6 is an image, not checked). Page sits behind a reCAPTCHA for some fetchers.

notes: Two research sources (Open-FF 2025, FracTracker 2024) name Diamondback, but only as a single-well example of trade-secret records, not an operator-wide rate. Open-FF gives the statewide Texas rate as 16.3% of chemical records (lead: 16.2%). No news outlet found naming Diamondback for trade-secret share, and no source states Diamondback's 30.3% or 96.7%-of-jobs figures. No post-2026-06-30 coverage found naming Diamondback on this. No disagreeing source found.
